decisions.reason: The optical spectrum service was moved up to the home page in 2019, which suggests it met or exceeded aspirations in the growing data-centre and hyperscaler wholesale segment, so it is unlikely to trigger problemistic search despite the missing archived pages.

The number ordering portal is a low-cost support tool for the voice business that survived the 2019 pruning of weaker voice and conferencing products, so a large firm's slack makes it cheap to keep even though its contribution is modest and voice is in decline.
